messages.text:
BL-1492 — The supervisor's response to a :stalled or :dead verdict is BL-144's full halt - kill every role session and the tmux server, then await a human - but babysitterd runs ./swarm ensure three to eight minutes later regardless, so the human gate never fires and the only lasting effect of each halt is nine agents losing their in-flight context (150 times since 2026-07-15, 26 on 2026-09-07); the supervisor restarts the daemon in place under a bounded budget, alarms and audits each restart, and keeps BL-144's full halt as the escalation once the budget is spent
What it solves: - Minted 2026-09-08 by the specifier as the decision half of the intake's
  second defect; BL-1491 is the firm half. Grepped first: BL-144 (done)
  set the halt; BL-690 (done) made ensure START rather than halt; BL-303
  (done) built the front-desk supervisor's healthy-uptime re-arm; nothing
  prop…
Approval context: Your approval here IS the decision, so this is deliberately a yes/no and carries no ruling_op…
BL-1492 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1492" (or "reject BL-1492 <reason>") to act.
